title: Describe the full local-refusal change in its successor commit message
outcome: The next integration candidate for the local unclassified-refusal contribution has a commit message describing the complete change, while the existing candidate remains immutable.
acceptance: When the required fresh candidate is created at the integration owner's placement, its subject and body describe the complete local-refusal recovery contribution and its relevant behavior rather than only formatting.

The new candidate preserves the reviewed contribution exactly, proven by no-renames raw path/status/mode/pre- and post-blob equality with the reviewed input; no amend, rebase or history rewrite is used.
